basis: Andrew Fisher, 4 Nov 2026 07:2x AEST: "P44 left yesterday at 3pm. P41 left yesterday at 930am". P41 (Coates 1189412, building 4.8-6 m, contract 9968862 L63, KINP) is on the record as left 3 Nov 09:00 (run 109, read from "P56 left p41 po8 left 9am"); its true departure is 3 Nov 09:30, the time he first gave ("1189412 leaving at 930am"), so the entry the Record departure form wrote is re-dated. P44 (Coates 198481, building 4.8-6 m, KINP) left site at 15:00 on 3 Nov: it leaves in full through the page's own Record departure form in his name. This also settles his 3 Nov message "P41 left at 3pm": the 3pm building was P44. Applied only if the dry run shows the P&L unchanged.
